title: Follow one conditional branch
description: You compare a stored age with the threshold in a single if statement.

steps.description: You store 38 in age. The conditional reads age without changing it.
You compare age with 35 using >=. This comparison supplies the condition for the next line.

steps.question: For the supplied age, does the program reach the print call?
steps.answer: Yes. The stored age meets the comparison on line 3.

steps.description: You reach the print call in the supplied recording. Its output contains the eligibility message written in the string.
